final_answer.user_question: Find 5 Indian B2B SaaS startups in HR tech and summarize their positioning.
final_answer.short_answer: The Indian HR Tech B2B SaaS market is sharply stratified into enterprise conglomerates, mid-market tech companies, and SMBs. Darwinbox dominates enterprise accounts competing with Workday; Keka leads the mid-market with intuitive payroll and UX; Zimyo targets SMBs via embedded employee financial benefits; greytHR serves long-tail compliance; and inFeedo leverages AI sentiment to prevent employee churn.

key_findings.title: Darwinbox: Enterprise Conglomerate Positioning
key_findings.finding: Darwinbox targets large-scale enterprises with 1,000+ employees (e.g., Adani, Mahindra), positioning itself as a modular, mobile-first alternative to legacy ERPs like SAP and Workday across Asia [1].

key_findings.title: Keka: Mid-Market & SME Delight
key_findings.finding: Keka focuses on tech-forward mid-market companies (100–2,000 employees), differentiating on automated statutory payroll compliance (PF/ESI/TDS) and zero-friction employee self-service [1].

key_findings.title: Zimyo: SMB FinTech & Benefits Integration
key_findings.finding: Zimyo addresses smaller businesses (20–300 staff) by combining core HR workflows with embedded financial wellness tools such as on-demand earned wage access and insurance [1].

key_findings.title: greytHR & inFeedo: Compliance Scale and AI Engagement
key_findings.finding: greytHR maintains dominance in high-volume payroll compliance for established SMBs, while inFeedo specializes in conversational AI (Amber) to detect employee disengagement and flight risk [1].

baseline_comparison.direct_llm_answer: Some Indian HR startups include Darwinbox, ZingHR, Keka, and maybe BambooHR or Workday. Darwinbox is big in India. Keka does payroll. ZingHR is also an HR software. There is also Zoho People. They all help HR managers manage employee leaves, attendance, and payroll.

Baseline provided superficial generic descriptions ('they all help HR managers') without analyzing actual market positioning or customer segments (Enterprise vs Mid-Market vs SMB).
Baseline missed specialized modern players like Zimyo (fintech benefits) and inFeedo (AI employee churn sentiment).
